What if you drank orange juice every single morning?
It's the classic breakfast drink in many homes. One glass gives you more than a full day of vitamin C. It also has potassium and folate.

But here's the twist. Orange juice has nearly as much sugar as the same amount of soda, and without the fiber of a whole orange it hits your blood sugar faster. It takes about three oranges to make one glass, so it's easy to drink a lot of sugar fast. Experts suggest eating the whole fruit, or keeping juice to one small glass a day.
